title: a new suppression with no reason on its line

explain.what: The branch adds a suppression (# noqa, # type: ignore, # pyright: ignore, #[allow] / #[expect], eslint-disable) with no reason on its line.
explain.why: Switching a linter off where it fires is the cheapest way to clear a finding. A suppression that says why can be judged; one that says nothing hides the finding from every later reader.
explain.fix: Fix what the linter found and delete the suppression. If it must stay, say why on its line: `# noqa: F401  # re-exported for the plugin API`, `#[allow(x, reason = "...")]` or `// eslint-disable-next-line x -- why`.

head.a.py:
import sys
import os  # noqa: F401

import sys  # noqa: F401
import os  # noqa: F401 # re-exported for the plugin API
head.b.rs:
#[allow(dead_code, reason = "kept for the save format")]
fn x() {}
